title: Spore
author: Dangerous_Three_8506
selftext:
A good idea for everyone like me, (poor, learning, starting a new hobby), is to ask Astra to build the Spore Building Editor. You can also ask for the other ones, but the Building editor is great. It's so much simpler than blender (you know for the stupid like me). You can then customize the building editor with requests to Codex.

I setup mine, its' kind of poor so I'm not gonna share. Next week when I have tokens I am going to recreate it.

https://preview.redd.it/eacs1d8bk6qh1.png?width=1024&format=png&auto=webp&s=a9510aba5156efa5095c6522c20ee71186dd2a66

You need to tune astra to ignore certain game features like: Entertainment, House, City Hall, Factory.
